title: Draw Any Population You Like
summary: Draw a population as lopsided as you can and watch the exact distribution of its sample mean become a bell curve anyway, at a rate you can read off the screen.

sources.title: Feller, An Introduction to Probability Theory and Its Applications, Vol. I, Ch. X
NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods, §1.3.6.6.1 Normal Distribution
